name: Abi et Olivier
description: Deck de l'événement : classique, jazz, rock et pop, 1714–2024

cards.title: Concerto in D Minor, BWV 974: Adagio
cards.notes: Bach's transcription of Marcello's oboe concerto, c. 1713–14. Víkingur Ólafsson recording.

cards.title: Prelude & Fugue in C Minor, BWV 847
cards.notes: Well-Tempered Clavier Book I. Listed twice in the event's requests; one card. András Schiff recording.

cards.title: Keyboard Sonata in A Major, K. 322
cards.notes: Exact composition date unknown; 1753 is the date on the title page of Venice Libro 6, its manuscript source. Michelangeli recording.

cards.title: Orfeo ed Euridice: Dance of the Blessed Spirits
cards.notes: Karajan / Berlin Philharmonic recording.

cards.title: Piano Sonata No. 11, K. 331: Rondo alla Turca
cards.notes: Composed c. 1783, published 1784. András Schiff recording.

cards.title: Piano Sonata No. 21, D. 960: I. Molto moderato
cards.notes: Marc-André Hamelin recording, as requested.

cards.title: Waldszenen, Op. 82: Vogel als Prophet
cards.notes: Composed 1848–49. No. 7 chosen as the best-known movement. Maria João Pires recording.

cards.title: Piano Sonata in B Minor, S. 178
cards.notes: Completed 1853. Whole sonata as one track (Tomoki Sakata); the well-known recordings are only on Spotify as excerpts.

cards.title: Arabesque No. 1
cards.notes: Composed 1888–91, published 1891; start of composition used. Jean-Efflam Bavouzet recording.

cards.title: Prelude in C-sharp Minor, Op. 3 No. 2
cards.notes: Rachmaninoff's own Ampico piano-roll recording.

cards.title: Sonatine: I. Modéré
cards.notes: Jean-Yves Thibaudet recording.

cards.title: Tea for Two
cards.notes: Event deck uses the original composition year (Vincent Youmans, 1924). Audio is Tatum's 1933 recording; the requested 1939 one is not on Spotify.

cards.title: Sing, Sing, Sing
cards.notes: Event deck uses the original composition year: Louis Prima wrote and first recorded it in 1936. Audio is Goodman's 1937 studio recording (8:40), not the 1938 Carnegie Hall live cut.

cards.title: Waltz for Debby
cards.notes: Composition year: first recorded on New Jazz Conceptions (1956). Audio is the famous 1961 Village Vanguard trio take.

cards.title: Time Remembered
cards.notes: Evans's first recording of his own tune (1962 Interplay sessions, issued only in 1982). First released recording was 1966; 1962 used as the closest documented composition date.

cards.title: You Look Good to Me
cards.notes: From We Get Requests (1964), the song's first notable recording.

cards.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
Graceful Ghost Rag
cards.notes: Marc-André Hamelin recording.

cards.title: Spain
cards.notes: From Light as a Feather (recorded 1972, released 1973), the tune's first release.

cards.title: Early Summer
cards.notes: From Scenery (1976); only the 2025 remaster turned up as an album copy.

cards.title: Ashitaka and San
cards.notes: Composition year: the theme first appeared on the 1996 Image Album. Audio is the 1997 film soundtrack version.

cards.title: Infernal (Le Bossu de Notre-Dame)
cards.notes: Spotify only has it combined with Une douce lueur. startOffsetMs is an UNVERIFIED estimate of where Infernal begins; confirm by ear.

cards.title: All the Small Things
cards.notes: Enema of the State released June 1999; single followed Jan 2000. Album year used.

cards.title: Blood, Sex and Booze
cards.notes: Original Warning recording, not the 2025 anniversary remaster.

cards.title: Fat Lip
cards.notes: Original All Killer No Filler recording, not the 2026 remaster.

cards.title: Toxic
cards.notes: In The Zone released Nov 2003; single followed Jan 2004. Album year used, as the song reached the public first there.

cards.title: Snow (Hey Oh)
cards.notes: Stadium Arcadium released May 2006; single followed Nov 2006. Album year used.

cards.title: Spectronizer
cards.notes: Written for Just Dance 3 (2011); the only Spotify copy sits on a 2020 Just Dance compilation.

cards.title: What Makes You Beautiful
cards.notes: Single released Sept 2011; Up All Night followed in Nov 2011.

cards.title: Gaddaar
cards.notes: Single released Nov 2021; Rakshak followed in Feb 2022.

cards.title: Patricia
cards.notes: Studio version from Durango; the requested Durango Studio Session video is not on Spotify as such.

cards.title: Alicia (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33)
cards.notes: The game's main theme, from the official soundtrack. First released on the 2024 reveal-edition single; the game and full OST followed in 2025.
